misconfigurations.scenario: Deployed API Gateway REST API stage does not publish access logs
misconfigurations.alert_criteria: A deployed REST API stage omits accessLogSettings, destinationArn, or format
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Configure structured access logging to an existing reviewed CloudWatch Logs group and include request identifiers
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: Access logs provide caller, request, route, response, and latency evidence needed for incident response and operations. Configure a reviewed destination and format without logging authorization headers, secrets, or request bodies.
misconfigurations.output_notes: Return API and stage identifiers plus the presence of destination and format. Do not return log contents.
misconfigurations.notes: Access logging and execution logging are independent controls.

misconfigurations.scenario: Deployed API Gateway REST API stage has execution logging disabled
misconfigurations.alert_criteria: A deployed REST API stage has no method setting with loggingLevel=ERROR or INFO for each deployed method
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Enable ERROR or INFO execution logging after configuring the regional API Gateway CloudWatch role
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: Execution logging records API execution errors and traces that support troubleshooting and incident response. ERROR is the minimum safe level; data tracing remains separate and should stay disabled in production unless explicitly required because it can expose sensitive payloads.
misconfigurations.output_notes: Return API, stage, and affected method paths with logging level only. Never recommend dataTraceEnabled by default.
misconfigurations.notes: Treat wildcard method settings as covering matching deployed methods.

misconfigurations.scenario: Deployed API Gateway REST API stage has AWS X-Ray tracing disabled
misconfigurations.alert_criteria: A deployed REST API stage reports tracingEnabled=false
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Enable active X-Ray tracing after reviewing trace sampling, downstream instrumentation, privacy, and cost
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: X-Ray traces requests through API Gateway and downstream services, improving root-cause analysis and service-map visibility. Review sampling, data handling, and cost before enabling it in high-volume environments.
misconfigurations.output_notes: Return API and stage identifiers plus the tracing flag only.
misconfigurations.notes: This is an observability recommendation and should remain low severity unless workload policy requires tracing.

misconfigurations.scenario: API Gateway REST method allows unauthenticated access
misconfigurations.alert_criteria: A deployed non-OPTIONS REST API method reports authorizationType=NONE and is not explicitly exempted
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Confirm whether the method is intentionally public, then configure IAM, Cognito, or a reviewed Lambda authorizer where authentication is required
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: Methods with authorizationType NONE can be invoked without API Gateway authentication. Public endpoints may be intentional, so the finding must show the exact API, resource path, and method and support explicit resource-tag exemptions before recommending an authorization change.
misconfigurations.output_notes: Return API, resource path, HTTP method, and authorization type only. Never return integration credentials or request templates.
misconfigurations.notes: OPTIONS methods are excluded because they commonly support CORS preflight.
